content.title: Image caption circle
content.summary: Participants share images, receive two other images, and caption one.
content.setup: Invite at least three participants and choose a source opening, source deadline, response deadline, and round ID.
content.prompt: Share an image that could inspire a playful caption.
content.participant: Submit one image before the source deadline. If enough images arrive, request two others and caption one before the response deadline.
content.completion: At the response deadline, submitted sources and linked responses become visible to the group. Missing responses do not delay the reveal.
content.access: Participants need access to image upload and viewing as well as text entry. Hosts must store and authorize actual image references.

provenance.rights: Illustrative package content; reuse terms have not been specified.
